thread:
maria: Quick follow-up from the postmortem. We still have a residual set of ~1.2k invoices affected by delayed token ingestion. Need to lock owners, remediation approach, and a clear timeline.
kevin: I can own the reprocess logic. Plan: add dedupe at the ingest join, shorten retry/backoff for late batches, and emit a reprocess marker. Owner: kevin. ETA: EOW for a PR. :thumbsup:
sam: I will stand up a transient backfill runner (spot instances) so the backfill doesn't impact prod capacity. Need CSV of accounts + rough compute estimate to schedule.
maria: Natalie, can you split which invoices can be auto-credited vs need manual review? Also flag enterprise/reserved accounts.
natalie: On it. Early numbers: ~920 auto-credit candidates, ~300 manual adjustments (enterprise/legal review). I'll publish a CSV with expected_tokens and actual_tokens and a flag column. Owner: natalie. ETA: tomorrow 10:00 PT.
raj: Observed recurring pattern: ingest lag spikes on Tuesdays after deploy windows. Proposal: add a canary pipeline check and an alert rule. Owner: raj. Suggested threshold: ingest lag > 45m affecting >2% of requests in 1h window.
kevin: SQL used to enumerate accounts:```sql
SELECT account_id, count(*) AS delayed_count
FROM token_ingest_log
WHERE processed_ts - event_ts > 3600
GROUP BY account_id
ORDER BY delayed_count DESC
LIMIT 500;
```
maria: Good. Billing ops will want a per-invoice token delta column so reconciliation is straightforward.
natalie: CSV will include invoice_id, account_id, expected_tokens, actual_tokens, delta_tokens, auto_credit_flag, enterprise_flag. For manual adj rows we also include reason_code and required_approver.
kevin: For auto credits I propose a tagged credit job: ledger updates with memo=postmortem-2960001234 for traceability. I'll add a PR and changelog entry.
sam: Backfill estimate: current parallel quota gives ~6h runtime for the full set. If dedupe cuts duplicates we'll be ~3h. Scheduling planned after kevin's patch lands.
maria: Important orchestration note: to avoid double-adjustments we must run reprocess backfill first, then compute remaining deltas and apply credits only for residuals. No concurrent apply/double-run.
kevin: Execution plan: (1) land dedupe + marker, (2) run backfill, (3) compute diff CSV, (4) apply auto credits for rows marked auto, (5) surface manual adj tickets for flagged enterprise accounts. I'll document a playbook in the PR.
natalie: I'll draft manual adjustment ticket template including legal approval steps and attach supporting CSV slice.
raj: I'll add a Grafana panel for weekly ingest-lag patterns and a permanent alert. Also propose a weekly digest to ops for early detection.
maria: Owner recap & timeline: kevin - reprocess code (PR by EOW), sam - backfill infra (schedule once PR merges, tentative Sat 02:00 PT), natalie - CSV & manual tickets (tomorrow 10:00 PT), raj - monitoring + alert (tomorrow EOD). Credits to run Mon after verification.
kevin: Filing JIRA BILL-6182 for the work and linking PR/patch notes here.
maria: Please update this thread as you make progress. Ping me if you hit blockers. Thanks team. :heart:
